At the end of this month, we will finally have a congressperson for Texas’s 18th Congressional District. I promise you that if I win, I won’t go to Washington and shrink. name: Nishu Siddique
subject: Want to take a bigger role in Team Menefee?
body:
Team Menefee,
We’re headed to a runoff on May 26, and we’re building the team that’s going to win it.
A lot of you have already knocked doors, made calls, delivered yard signs, and played a pivotal role in Congressman Menefee's success. As we head into this next stretch, we want to share the opportunity for you to take a more active role in keeping Christian in Congress!
We’ve started a few Team Menefee committees so folks can plug in more consistently:
**• Block Walk Committee:** [Sign up here!](https://mobilize.us/s/v35HhH)
**• Phone Bank Committee:** [Sign up here!](https://mobilize.us/s/v5vQDi)
**• Yard Sign Committee:**[Sign up here!](https://mobilize.us/s/fW3myV)
**• Women for Menefee:** [Sign up here!](https://mobilize.us/s/54Jjfz)
We’re also continuing our regular volunteer events:
• **Remote phone banks every Tuesday and Thursday:**[Sign up here](https://mobilize.us/s/VvYDWY)
• **Block walks every weekend:**[Sign up here](https://www.mobilize.us/christianmenefeeforcongress/?page=0&per_page=25)
We're always looking for events for Congressman Menefee and the team to attend to connect with the community. If you have any recommendations, please feel free to reach out here or to [team@christianmenefee.com](mailto:team@christianmenefee.com)!
And one more thing — Team Menefee is looking to hire two paid interns. If you know a high school, college, or post-grad student who wants to get involved in the runoff, please share the application with them:
<https://forms.gle/9oZbFdq7hyBKaswR9>
And we know we reach out a lot by call and text. If there’s a better way for you to get involved or help lead something, we’d love to hear it.

\--

Warmly,
Nishu Dada
Organizer for Christian Menefee for Congress Campaign
